title: fix(runtime): os serve --artifact-fallback mounts the knowledge service for an artifact-only stack's knowledge sources
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwPhGV4g9p1BGQaZbP

Fixes #38039

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：没有配置文件、直接用构建产物启动应用时，只要应用带了知识源，就会像从配置文件启动一样自动挂载知识服务；以前这条路径下知识源不会被建索引。
- 为什么做：知识库检索专题中“带知识源即挂载知识服务”一项的收尾，替直接从构建产物部署应用的团队（托管运行时读的就是这个形状）解决两种启动方式挂载结果不一致的问题。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是从构建产物启动、且带知识源的应用多挂载了一个知识服务；已经声明需要知识服务的应用不受影响，改动可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

`createStandaloneStack` (`packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts`), and so `createDefaultHostConfig`, which returns its result, now surfaces every stack collection that a `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` row names as its `mountedBy`. Today that is `knowledgeSources`. The list is read from the table by a module-private `stackItemMountCollections()`, so a later `mountedBy` row is surfaced with no edit here. Each collection is read from the same resolved artifact (`resolveArtifactCollections`) that `objects` / `permissions` / `positions` are read from, so a multi-package artifact's package bodies are covered. `StandaloneStackResult` gains the optional `knowledgeSources?: any[]`.

The CLI needs no change. Its artifact-serve path builds `config = mergeBootConfig({}, bootResult)`. That is a whole-value spread for every key but `api`, so the new key reaches `stackItemCapabilities(config)` and `resolveServedCapabilities(…, { itemTokens })` in `serve.ts` unchanged. This was confirmed by a real boot (Verification).

Clause-② judgement: the claim reads `no`, and this PR declares `yes (widening)`. `StandaloneStackResult` is exported from `@objectstack/runtime` and is the return type of the exported `createStandaloneStack`, so a new optional member widens the public surface. It is additive, so it is a widening and not a narrowing. Metadata-protocol stays `none`: nothing an author writes changes. The changeset is `@objectstack/runtime: patch`.

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.ts`: the `itemCollections` block before `return`, and the spread at the end of the returned object.
2. `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack.test.ts`: the new top-level `describe` (ADR-0161 K8 item 12).
3. `.changeset/38039-artifact-serve-item-mount.md`.

## Tests

The new top-level `describe` in `standalone-stack.test.ts` (the shared harness file of this factory) has six cases:
- The mounting collections are package-owned (`packageOwnedCollectionKeys()`), so an option-B artifact resolves them from its package bodies.
- An artifact with a `knowledge_source` and no `requires`: the result carries `knowledgeSources`, plus every `mountedBy` collection read from the table.
- The same artifact: `os serve`'s chain (result spread as the config, `stackDeclaredCapabilities` + `stackItemCapabilities` into `resolveServedCapabilities`) serves `knowledge`, whose provider row is `KnowledgeServicePlugin`.
- Control: an artifact with no such item gets no `knowledgeSources` and no `knowledge` token.
- A stack already listing `requires: ['knowledge']` is served the same token list with or without the item.
- `createDefaultHostConfig`, the function the artifact-fallback path calls, mounts the token and carries the collection.

The test file also gains module-top `import '@objectstack/objectql'` and `import '@objectstack/metadata'`. `check:test-source-alias` judges an edited test file and asked for them, because the factory reaches both through a dynamic import inside a clocked window.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, reported to the seat for filing: `os migrate plan` on the same artifact-only stack still composes no `KnowledgeServicePlugin`. `composeServedPlatform` reads `stackItemCapabilities(loadedConfig ?? {})`, and only `stack.requires` is handed over from the standalone result (`schema-migrate.ts`, the `servedPlatform` argument). Measured on the same artifact: the "Composed what `os serve` mounts" note lists no knowledge service, and ObjectQLPlugin warns that the source is unserved.
- Out of scope, reported: that unserved-source warning reads "so it is loaded, indexed or searched" for one item. It is missing a negation. The plural form ("none is loaded") is correct.

## Verification

Two-minute check: in a directory holding only `dist/objectstack.json` (built from a stack with one `knowledgeSources` entry and no `requires`), run `OS_AUTH_SECRET=… os serve --dev -p 38391 --log-level info`. The log shows `Plugin registered: com.objectstack.service.knowledge` and `KnowledgeServicePlugin: knowledge_source items loaded. Added: notes.`, then `Server is ready`. The same boot of an artifact with no source shows no `com.objectstack.service.knowledge` line.

<details><summary>Real boot, artifact-only (no objectstack.config.ts), built CLI at this branch</summary>

- With source: `No objectstack.config.ts found — booting from artifact (default host)...`, then `Plugin registered: com.objectstack.service.knowledge@0.1.0`, `[Registry] Registered knowledge_source: com.example.os38039:notes`, `KnowledgeServicePlugin: knowledge_source items loaded. Added: notes.`, `[knowledge] adapter registered: turso`, `✓ Server is ready`. 6 lines name `com.objectstack.service.knowledge`.
- Control (same object, no source): `✓ Server is ready`, 0 lines name `com.objectstack.service.knowledge`.
- `os build` of the source stack writes `knowledgeSources` at the artifact's top level, and no `requires`.

</details>
